programs.title: Swamp People
programs.desc: A drought and sweltering temperatures drop water levels to their lowest point in decades, and access to the best honey holes in the swamp are nearly impassable. Hunters take huge risks to fill tags.

programs.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programs.desc: The evidence is building, and the team believes they are finally zeroing in on the Treasure Vault. With confidence at an all-time high, the Fellowship prepares to retrieve it as they call in the caissons.

programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: The dangerous, emotional, and arduous toll of stealth ops has never been felt more deeply than by those who adopted completely separate personas to integrate themselves into a shadowy underworld.

programs.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programs.desc: For centuries, powerful artefacts have sparked wars, inspired legends, and shaped empires. From divine weapons to sacred relics-these are the incredible stories of the world's most mighty marvels.

programs.title: The Death Coast
programs.sub_title: Into The Eye Of The Storm
programs.desc: Jeff MacKinnon's team battles thick kelp, brutal currents, and a looming storm while searching Scatarie Island's coast. Just as the storm hits, they make a crucial discovery.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Lauro nears the end of the Iditarod, crossing 260 miles of ice along the Bering Sea coast to reach the finish line in Nome; Marty and his friend Dave haul supplies for a cabin into the backcountry.
